commands.label: Docker
commands.text:
docker run -d --name n --restart always \
  -e REPO_URL=http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web -e RUNNER_TOKEN=AAA \
  -e RUNNER_NAME=n -e RUNNER_SCOPE=repo -e LABELS=a,b \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  myoung34/github-runner:latest

commands.label: Linux
commands.text:
mkdir -p actions-runner && cd actions-runner
V=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
curl -sL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$V/actions-runner-linux-x64-$V.tar.gz
tar xzf runner.tar.gz
./config.sh --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token AAA --name n --labels a,b --unattended
sudo ./svc.sh install && sudo ./svc.sh start

commands.label: macOS
commands.text:
mkdir -p actions-runner && cd actions-runner
V=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
curl -sL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$V/actions-runner-osx-arm64-$V.tar.gz
tar xzf runner.tar.gz
./config.sh --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token AAA --name n --labels a,b --unattended
./svc.sh install && ./svc.sh start

commands.label: Windows
commands.text:
New-Item -Path C:\actions-runner -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null; cd C:\actions-runner
$v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest).tag_name.TrimStart('v')
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$v/actions-runner-win-x64-$v.zip" -OutFile runner.zip
Expand-Archive runner.zip -DestinationPath . -Force
.\config.cmd --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token AAA --name n --labels a,b --unattended --runasservice

issues.how: Задание будет ждать в статусе Queued, пока не появится подходящий раннер (до 24 часов), затем отменится.
issues.why: Ни у одного раннера в сети нет этого тега.
issues.fix: Проверьте опечатки в тегах или подключите раннер с этими тегами (вкладка «Раннеры» → «Подключить раннер»).

issues.title: No active runners with the tag "нет-такой" — the pipeline will hang in the queue (Pending)!
issues.how: The job will wait in Queued status until a matching runner appears (up to 24 hours), then get canceled.
issues.why: No online runner has this tag.

commands.label: Docker
commands.text:
docker run -d --name n --restart always \
  -e GITEA_INSTANCE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:49751 \
  -e GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN=T1 \
  -e GITEA_RUNNER_NAME=n -e GITEA_RUNNER_LABELS=a \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -v n-data:/data \
  gitea/act_runner:latest

commands.label: Linux
commands.text:
# Свежая версия act_runner: https://gitea.com/gitea/act_runner/releases
curl -L -o act_runner https://dl.gitea.com/act_runner/nightly/act_runner-nightly-linux-amd64 && chmod +x act_runner
./act_runner register --no-interactive --instance http://{{HOST}} --token T1 --name n --labels a
nohup ./act_runner daemon > act_runner.log 2>&1 &

commands.label: macOS
commands.text:
curl -L -o act_runner https://dl.gitea.com/act_runner/nightly/act_runner-nightly-darwin-arm64 && chmod +x act_runner
./act_runner register --no-interactive --instance http://{{HOST}} --token T1 --name n --labels a
nohup ./act_runner daemon > act_runner.log 2>&1 &

commands.label: Windows
commands.text:
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://dl.gitea.com/act_runner/nightly/act_runner-nightly-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile act_runner.exe
.\act_runner.exe register --no-interactive --instance http://{{HOST}} --token T1 --name n --labels a
.\act_runner.exe daemon

  -e REPO_URL=http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web -e RUNNER_TOKEN=undefined \

commands.label: Linux
commands.text:
mkdir -p actions-runner && cd actions-runner
V=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
curl -sL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$V/actions-runner-linux-x64-$V.tar.gz
tar xzf runner.tar.gz
./config.sh --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-hlai --unattended
sudo ./svc.sh install && sudo ./svc.sh start

commands.label: macOS
commands.text:
mkdir -p actions-runner && cd actions-runner
V=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
curl -sL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$V/actions-runner-osx-arm64-$V.tar.gz
tar xzf runner.tar.gz
./config.sh --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-hlai --unattended
./svc.sh install && ./svc.sh start

commands.label: Windows
commands.text:
New-Item -Path C:\actions-runner -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null; cd C:\actions-runner
$v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest).tag_name.TrimStart('v')
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$v/actions-runner-win-x64-$v.zip" -OutFile runner.zip
Expand-Archive runner.zip -DestinationPath . -Force
.\config.cmd --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-hlai --unattended --runasservice

commands.label: Docker
commands.text:
docker run -d --name n --restart always \
  -e GITEA_INSTANCE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:50674 \
  -e GITEA_RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN=T1 \
  -e GITEA_RUNNER_NAME=n -e GITEA_RUNNER_LABELS=a \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -v n-data:/data \
  gitea/act_runner:latest

commands.label: Linux
commands.text:
# Свежая версия act_runner: https://gitea.com/gitea/act_runner/releases
curl -L -o act_runner https://dl.gitea.com/act_runner/nightly/act_runner-nightly-linux-amd64 && chmod +x act_runner
./act_runner register --no-interactive --instance http://{{HOST}} --token T1 --name n --labels a
nohup ./act_runner daemon > act_runner.log 2>&1 &

commands.label: macOS
commands.text:
curl -L -o act_runner https://dl.gitea.com/act_runner/nightly/act_runner-nightly-darwin-arm64 && chmod +x act_runner
./act_runner register --no-interactive --instance http://{{HOST}} --token T1 --name n --labels a
nohup ./act_runner daemon > act_runner.log 2>&1 &

commands.label: Windows
commands.text:
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://dl.gitea.com/act_runner/nightly/act_runner-nightly-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile act_runner.exe
.\act_runner.exe register --no-interactive --instance http://{{HOST}} --token T1 --name n --labels a
.\act_runner.exe daemon

commands.label: Linux
commands.text:
mkdir -p actions-runner && cd actions-runner
V=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
curl -sL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$V/actions-runner-linux-x64-$V.tar.gz
tar xzf runner.tar.gz
./config.sh --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-kml3 --unattended
sudo ./svc.sh install && sudo ./svc.sh start

commands.label: macOS
commands.text:

curl -sL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$V/actions-runner-osx-arm64-$V.tar.gz

./config.sh --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-kml3 --unattended
./svc.sh install && ./svc.sh start

commands.label: Windows
commands.text:
New-Item -Path C:\actions-runner -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null; cd C:\actions-runner
$v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest).tag_name.TrimStart('v')
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$v/actions-runner-win-x64-$v.zip" -OutFile runner.zip
Expand-Archive runner.zip -DestinationPath . -Force
.\config.cmd --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-kml3 --unattended --runasservice

commands.label: Linux
commands.text:
mkdir -p actions-runner && cd actions-runner
V=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')

./config.sh --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-ksrv --unattended

commands.text:

V=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
curl -sL -o runner.tar.gz https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$V/actions-runner-osx-arm64-$V.tar.gz

commands.text:

$v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/actions/runner/releases/latest).tag_name.TrimStart('v')
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$v/actions-runner-win-x64-$v.zip" -OutFile runner.zip
Expand-Archive runner.zip -DestinationPath . -Force
.\config.cmd --url http://{{HOST}}/o/r-web --token undefined --name git-gorynych-ksrv --unattended --runasservice
